name: Concept F: pullrods to rockers on the low frame nodes, coil-overs low
summary: Pullrods hang from clevises on the upper wishbones, 42-46 mm inboard of the upper ball joints, and pull bell-crank rockers bracketed off the lowest frame nodes. Front: the rocker pivot is 55.3 mm from the front-hoop bottom node (9 tube ends, the busiest joint of the frame) and the coil-over runs forward, down and inboard, outside the front box's side, to an eye 58.0 mm from the floor/side node at the front of the box (5 tube ends). Rear: the rocker pivot is 54.1 mm from the rear lower node (5 tube ends), outboard of the chain, and the coil-over climbs up and back, outboard of the PST tube, to an eye 56.6 mm from the rear upper node (4 tube ends). Both rods are in tension (no buckling) and both rocker brackets and coil-over ends sit at welded joints. The trade-off: the lowest linkage of the four layouts (CG -4.55 mm against the seed) and rear coil-overs well clear of the differential space, against long rods swept strongly in plan (38.7 deg front, 53.6 deg rear), 2.4-2.6x the wheel load in the rods, a front that passes with thin margins between the two template boxes and the rack, a front coil-over outside the frame side and a rear rocker that hangs 7 mm below the rear frame rails. No evaluator threshold is missed on either axle. MR 0.80 at ride is the comparison query, not a choice.
pros: Zero evaluator fails on both axles and both corners, including the two node checks, against the chassis as updated and the engine on its mounts, swept to the damper end stops (front -35.6 / +35.2 mm, rear -35.9 / +35.6 mm) and, at the front, over the full rack travel of +-38 mm.

Brackets at welded joints. Front: rocker pivot 55.3 mm from the front-hoop bottom node (-120, 205, 117; 9 tube ends: 3DSketch3, FRONTO HO, PSD, Tri_Frente, Tri_Meio, assoalho frontal), pivot bracket 38.0 mm to the hoop's lower leg (foot 40 mm from the node); coil-over eye 58.0 mm from the floor/side node (120, 205, 117; 5 tube ends), bracket 37.8 mm (foot 44 mm from the node). Rear: pivot 54.1 mm from the rear lower node (-1272, 215, 129; 5 tube ends), bracket 30.7 mm (foot 45 mm from the node); eye 56.6 mm from the rear upper node (-1336, 255, 337; 4 tube ends), bracket 46.2 mm.

Lowest linkage of the node concepts: coil-over + rocker mass height 186 mm front and 215 mm rear (rocker / coil-over z range 147-234 mm front, 129-304 mm rear). CG -4.55 mm against the seed and tilt-table angle 62.47 deg (seed 62.13), with the estimated 1.3 kg coil-over + 0.3 kg rocker per corner.

Rods in tension, so buckling does not set the rod tube: front 353.0 mm, 1516 N at ride (2.59x the wheel load); rear 409.1 mm, 1782 N (2.41x). The clevises sit 42 mm (front) and 46 mm (rear) from the upper ball joints: hand estimate of the UCA leg bending from the rod-force component normal to the leg, simply supported, 48 N·m front and 35 N·m rear at ride (about 91 / 67 MPa on a 25.4x1.2 mm tube; 272 / 200 MPa at 3x static).

Kinematics over +-25 mm: MR 0.80 / 0.80 / 0.82 front (+2.6 %) and 0.79 / 0.80 / 0.80 rear (+2.1 %), equal damper margins 8.4 / 8.5 mm. Largest transmission angles to the end stops 13.6 deg (rod) / 24.8 deg (coil-over) front, 19.3 / 28.9 deg rear; rocker rotation -12.6 / +12.2 deg front, -22.3 / +21.2 deg rear.

Rear coil-overs outboard of the chain line and away from the axle centre: chain 11.0 mm (rocker, left at bump; estimate), drive shaft 74.5 mm, engine features 84.6 mm, left to right 487.1 mm. The rear linkage sits on the PST / Tri_Tras side structure, not in the differential's space.
Rocker pivot reactions at ride 1891 N front and 1325 N rear, bracket couples (upper bound, force x stand-off) 71.9 / 27.7 N·m front (pivot / coil-over end) and 40.7 / 42.7 N·m rear.
cons: Thin front margins. Coil-over eyes 5.1 mm from the PSD side tube at the droop stop, rocker 5.0 mm from the LCA rear leg (bump, rack +38), coil-over 5.2 mm from the estimated rack housing (droop), rod 6.6 mm from the UCA front leg (bump, rack +38), against 5 mm limits. The front linkage also fills the 70 mm slot between the two CAD solid boxes behind the front hoop: the coil-over eye is 2.5 mm from 'Ressalto-extrusão2' (believed to be the leg template) and the rocker 2.6 mm from 'Ressalto-extrusão1' (taken to be the cockpit template), at the droop stop.

Long rods swept strongly in plan: 38.7 deg front and 53.6 deg rear from transverse (38.4 / 35.1 deg from horizontal). The rods carry 2.6x / 2.4x the wheel load; their fore-aft component loads the UCA clevis and the rocker sideways, and the rear rod reaches from behind the axle line (clevis at x -1513) forward to a rocker at x -1249.

The front coil-over lies outside the front box's side, in the side-pod / bodywork zone: from the rocker pickup at (-38, 329, 230) forward, down and inboard to the eye at (83, 198, 161), 21 deg from horizontal, crossing the LCA's inboard region (rocker 5.0 mm from the LCA rear leg). Bodywork, a side-impact structure or a cooling duct there would have to leave room for it.

The rear rocker hangs below the rear frame rails: its lowest point reaches z = 108.6 mm (chassis-referenced) over the travel, 7.3 mm below the underside of the rear lower tubes (115.9 mm). Ground clearance and the jacking / push-bar zone were not checked.

Pivot bolts: a pivot bolt the size of the evaluator's pickup bolts (+-20 mm along the axis, not modelled by the evaluator) would touch the front hoop's lower leg (-0.2 mm) at the front (6.5 mm clear at the rear), so the front pivot needs a one-sided stub or a shaped yoke at the hoop's foot.

Shared nodes: the front pivot shares the front-hoop bottom node with the LCA rear pivot and the floor tubes; the rear eye shares the rear upper node with the 3DSketch8 engine-mount tube and the rear pivot the rear lower node with the toe-link / LCA lower side. Bracket and clevis room at these joints is not modelled.

MR is slightly progressive on both axles (+2.6 % / +2.1 %), and the rear rocker turns +-22 deg with a 28.9 deg coil-over transmission angle at the end stops, the largest of the node concepts. Steering moves the front damper by 4.47 mm over the full rack travel (steering jacking, as for any mount).
No anti-roll-bar provision. The roll budget asks about 56.7 N·m/deg front and 77.7 N·m/deg rear for the 1.0 deg/g query target; low rockers leave the drop links near the floor.
not_checked: Ground clearance, the rear jacking point and the bodywork / side pods around the front coil-overs.
The differential and its sprocket carrier; the engine is modelled by its features and plenum outline only; the chain and sprockets (14/46 520 assumed) and the drive shafts are estimates.
The driver: the two front solid boxes are checked only as bounding boxes; leg protection for moving suspension parts beside the cockpit (FSAE rules).

Real part envelopes: all gaps use estimated diameters (rod 16, coil-over 60, eyes 40, rocker +-10 mm plates and +-20 mm pickup bolts, frame 25.4); brackets, clevises, the UCA clevis plates and the rod ends are not modelled.

Structure: no load cases, stress, fatigue or sizing of brackets, nodes, rockers, rods, wishbones or uprights; the UCA bending figures are hand estimates; bracket compliance, which changes the effective MR, is not modelled.

Travel limits: the damper stroke (57 mm) is an estimate and there are no bump rubbers. With 220 lb/in springs and no preload the springs unseat at -23.7 mm (front, inside the +-25 mm travel) and -30.0 mm (rear), as with any layout at MR 0.80.

The MR 0.80 target, the 1.0 deg/g roll gradient and the 50 % front roll share are design-intent query arguments, not derived targets. The 220 lb/in springs are a fixed input (measured; one of the two available rates).
